claims.verbatim:
Steamship Bavaria (Hamb.), Taube, Hamburg July 28 via South-
ampton Aug. 2, with mdse. and 278 pass. to Kunhardt & Co. Aug. 3,
lat. 49 41, long. 11, saw American ship Nerius[?] bound E; 7th, lat. 48[?] 40,
long. 30 10, bark H. Palmer (Br.), bound W; 12th, lat. 44, long. 58,
ship John DeWolf (Br.), bound W; same day, lat. 42 30[?], long 62,
steamship Ville de Paris; 13th, lat. 42 15, long. 53 12, Hamb. steamship
Germania, steamship City of Boston (Br.), steamship Hansa (Brem.),
and steamship Caledonia (Br.); 14th inst., passed pilot boat David
Mitchell with a dismasted brig in tow, making for Newport. The B.
has had five deaths from cholera on the passage, and there are at pres-
ent four cases of the same disease on board. The vessel has been
sent to the Lower Quarantine.
